name: MIA-Bench
intro: MIA-Bench 用 400 个图像-提示对评估多模态大模型对组合式复杂指令的严格遵循能力。论文从 COCO 2017 验证集、SBU、TextVQA 与 Flickr 取图，人工编写并拆分子指令，再由 GPT-4o 按组件权重评分。本站流程同时区分论文方法、固定公开 JSON 与 notebook 的实际解析和聚合行为。
build_method: COCO、SBU、TextVQA随机抽样与Flickr多主题图像（选择方法未披露）, GPT-4V内容标注（标签未发布）, 人工组合指令与三原则编写, 子指令分类及权重标注
metric: 主方法及表1/3：0至100的总分与八类分项；公开notebook及附录表6至9：0至1比率
eval_feature: 多模态GPT-4o裁判, 组件权重评分, 首句格式解析, 算术平均聚合
scale: 400个图像-提示对；每题2至5个子指令
build_method_en: Random sampling from COCO, SBU, and TextVQA plus diverse Flickr images with the selection method unreported, unreleased GPT-4V content labels, manual compositional instruction authoring under three principles, sub-instruction taxonomy and weights
eval_feature_en: Multimodal GPT-4o judge, component-weight scoring, first-sentence format parser, arithmetic-mean aggregation
intro_en: MIA-Bench evaluates strict compositional instruction following by multimodal large language models using 400 image-prompt pairs. The paper sources images from COCO 2017 validation, SBU, TextVQA, and Flickr, manually authors and decomposes instructions, and uses GPT-4o for component-weighted grading. This page distinguishes the paper method, the pinned public JSON, and the notebook's executable parsing and aggregation behavior.

drawio_review_note: Evidence-aligned to arXiv:2407.01509v5 Sections 2, 2.1, 2.2, Appendix A.3, and official repository commit 5422852d98cb167390da9501200360860435efb1. The pinned files are instruction_benchmark_all.json sha256 f75671cde32c84ee1791eda74994f15eaf48530333a65f3b732006a1c7d055d2, evaluation.ipynb sha256 790964af82f87e88bd2b2d4d638332a9cdeabd490976aec305117eba53d08244, and example_inference_result.jsonl sha256 9d5a62f5d2d2de5d16cb868a4dff5a2e2210afe782bcd6b85122c2d8681ca337. Construction boundary: the paper says COCO, SBU, and TextVQA are randomly sampled but only describes Flickr theme diversity, not a Flickr selection method; GPT-4V content labels support Figure 4 but are absent from the public JSON; correctness, no-answer-leakage, and image-dependence are authoring principles, with no published acceptance, rejection, or adjudication protocol. Release audit: 400 rows and 400 unique image strings, of which 399 are valid HTTP(S) and zero-based row 193 lacks a scheme; 398 unique instructions; complexity counts advanced/basic/complex/creative/intermediate = 54/45/65/45/191; component-count distribution 204/155/40/1 for 2/3/4/5; 22 rows with repeated categories; image_name on 80 rows but only 21 unique values, one repeated 60 times; paper-to-file names description/describe, genre/linguistics, OCR/textual. Against the paper's description-weight rule, zero-based rows 3, 9, 31, 308, 316, and 372 violate the single-description expectation, row 261 has two description components and is ambiguous, and rows 241 and 247 have weight sum 8 rather than 10. Evaluation boundary: README expects url+text but the one-row example uses question_id+prompt+text; the notebook pairs instructions by row position, never uses the benchmark image for judging, directly attaches the candidate row's url, and checks neither URL identity nor length/order completeness. text='error' and five exhausted judge attempts leave score_raw as its initialized integer, whereas a malformed judge reply remains a string; broad parser exceptions silently exclude all such rows and shrink effective denominators. The parser consumes only the punctuation-sensitive first sentence, does not validate component count, bounds, sums, or eight-category coverage, and overwrites repeated category keys. The main method and Tables 1/3 use 0-to-100 scores, while notebook outputs and Appendix Tables 6-9 use 0-to-1 ratios. Paper v5 compares gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, gpt-4o-2024-05-13, gpt-4o-2024-11-20, and chatgpt-4o-latest, finding different scores but a stable eight-model ranking and noting about 1% run variation; the notebook still requests unversioned gpt-4o with max_tokens=2000 and up to five bare-except attempts. Image files are unbundled, URLs are documented as unstable, and repository history contains three URL fixes. The repository carries a custom Apple Sample Code License and does not disclose source quotas/seed, annotator protocol, GPT-4V prompt/snapshot, a judge snapshot, dependency lock, tests, reference or judge outputs, complete-set guard, or hosted submission protocol. Section 3.2 SFT data is excluded as a downstream training study, not benchmark construction. Temporary strict builds completed for both languages with XML validation passed and 30 non-fatal advisories per language: one many-node warning plus 29 long-label info notices. Both 2381×1465 desktop PNGs were visually reviewed with aligned topology, readable labels, no clipping or node overlap, no duplicate edge labels, and no connector-node crossing. Formal publication evidence [site-a11l-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 2381×1465 (English) and 2381×1465 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 2379×1463 and 2379×1463. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
